title: Garmin Zumo Route Deviation Hotspots
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:zumo route_name=* off_route_events=*
| stats sum(off_route_events) as off_route_events, avg(distance_km) as avg_distance_km by route_name
| sort - off_route_events
description: Shows which saved routes generate the most off-route corrections or wrong-turn events.
value: Route deviation hotspots reveal confusing junctions, bad waypoints, or routes that are simply not fun on the bike.
implementation: Parse Zumo trip exports for off-route markers and summarize them by saved route.
visualization: Bar chart of off-route events by route.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which routes keep making you miss turns or wander off the planned line.
